description: This file contains the implementation of the comment listing feature for a web application. It defines a request and handler for retrieving comments associated with a specific article identified by its slug. The handler fetches comments and their authors from a database context, and handles the case where the article is not found by throwing an exception.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the request definition and handler for listing comments associated with an article

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the query to retrieve comments for a specific article identified by slug, fetching data from database and returning a comments envelope, throws exception if article not found
